session: This round was opened by the SESSION as M0-e-03's HARDENING ROUND S6 (J237 (2): the M0 hardening phase's fix rounds, batched per owning item; J238: M0 is the bedrock — the default for an M0 row is FIX with an exact precaution and a pin; J567: the bar is an independent closing check's PASS on the evidence), on THE CONTRACTS ROUND's consumer row for RL13 (queue Q205; the inventory's L26; docs/validation/hardening-retriage-2026-10-19/B7.md's 'L26 (reader of a-05's structured refusal)'): the water stage reads the refused body from the kernel's structured field, never from its text. Each 'failing line' below is one such row — an open queue row routed to this item (docs/M0-FIX-QUEUE.md) or a row the item's latest closing check wrote into its notes file; its evidence names the SOURCE you MUST read whole before fixing; the fix shape and the pin are the session's reading, binding unless the source or the code shows it wrong — then say so in your notes and do what the finding needs. THE RULES OF A HARDENING ROUND: (1) inside the item's owns and nowhere else — a row that needs another item's file is REPORTED, not built; (2) every row gets a PIN (a test that is red without the fix; your mutant table shows each pin killing its mutant) unless the row is comment-only or asks for a choices row — then the text is the deliverable; (3) BEHAVIOUR: a hardening fix may move output where a defect is fixed — a DECLARED shift, stated in your choices row with the before and after (digests and goldens re-recorded in the same round, named), never silent; where a row offers alternatives, take the one the design's text supports and say which; a change of an operation's or stage's CONTRACT (its design-level behaviour, a record or file format, an exported API) is NOT yours — report it as a note for the session's ruling and leave the row at REPORTED; (4) J264 / N-58: the refusal census of the item's registered families before and after the round, never rising (a row whose fix makes a lawful input succeed lowers it and says so); (5) API frozen (J263 Q1): no export of a folder index or the barrel added, removed or renamed unless a row explicitly asks for one — then the index change is the row's and stated; message texts pinned verbatim where a row changes one (J263 Q6); (6) the gates, NEAR and RELATED@1000 as the brief above says, at W=1; (7) the item's notes file gains a section 'Hardening round S6' with the row-by-row outcome (fixed / pinned / reported, each with its evidence and mutant), and the round's choices row names every row it closes. The CLOSING CHECKER confirms every row's outcome with its own evidence (re-reading the source note or queue row), re-kills every pin's mutant, re-measures the refusal census, and judges new findings by the blocker rule only; a row left REPORTED with a stated contract reason is not a failing line. THIS IS LEG 2 OF A MERGED ROUND OF THREE LEGS — THE CONTRACTS ROUND (the MERGED-ROUND RULE, J443): M0-a-06 S11 → M0-e-03 S6 → M0-c-04 S8, in that order, on ONE tree and ONE branch, no reset between, each leg with its own build, closing check, LANDED line and record; leg 2 launches only when leg 1 returned ok with check.verdict pass (it builds on it); leg 3 builds on leg 1 and on nothing of leg 2 (their write scopes share no file and no package), so it launches when leg 1 passed and leg 2 has RETURNED, whatever leg 2's verdict [SESSION: confirm or strike this clause at binding — the draft's open question 2]. THE ROUND CARRIES NO LEG OF M0-a-05: the queue rows' 'a-05' (Q205 'the field in insert/'; Q135 (a) 'M0-a-05's insert/') is corrected by the code — the refusal that names a body is made by the transaction at commit (kernel/src/tx/tx.ts roleProblems → run → reject), and a plan that commits nothing for a SEQUENCE of splits is a dry run, which only tx/ can open and undo (docs/validation/a05-contracts-spec-2026-11-13/draft.md §0, §1.1, §1.3 (c)). RULINGS BINDING (each read by its own grep, never the 1.3 MB file whole: grep '^| J637 ', '^| J648 ', '^| J800 ', '^| J263 ', '^| J264 ', '^| J238 ' docs/PROGRESS.md; and grep 'RL13\|RL15' docs/validation/hardening-retriage-2026-11-09/plan.md): RL13 (J637 (3); plan.md's ruling row): a STRUCTURED FIELD on the kernel's refusal naming the refused body — YES, ADDITIVE — the refusal codes and detail texts unchanged; M0-e-03 reads it in its following touch (queue Q205). RL15 (J648; plan.md's ruling row; queue Q135): the always-rejected planning batch of S5a's gate plan is removed by the kernel's plan that commits nothing — seam (a), in the form the session ruled after this spec's review: the kernel's DRY RUN (`dryRun` in tx/tx.ts, `Kernel.dryRun` on the façade) [SESSION: the ruled form is filled at binding]. J800 (2)–(3): Q135 stays M0's (J238 (1)) and is bound with RL13 into THE CONTRACTS ROUND, specced with its adversarial review. J263: Q1 — the API is frozen: no export of a folder index or of the barrel is added, removed or renamed by this round (the new types and functions are read BY PATH; the public surface that changes is the `Kernel` interface's `tx` return type and its new `dryRun` member, which RL13 / RL15 rule); Q6 — every pinned message text stays verbatim. J264: zero refusals of lawful input — the refusal census of the item's registered families before and after, never rising. J238 (1)–(3): nothing is carried, narrowed or waived for pace. THIS SPEC TOOK ITS ADVERSARIAL REVIEW (J631 (2) (a): a contract between items): [SESSION: the review's path, its findings and the rulings file that answers them are named here at binding; where a line below and the rulings file disagree, the rulings file binds and the seat says so in its notes]. THE DRAFT this entry was cut from (docs/validation/a05-contracts-spec-2026-11-13/draft.md) is evidence, never binding over this entry. THE GATE: the round opens on the design head AFTER M0-a-06 S10 (the RQ2 round's second leg, which edits tx/) has landed; it reads nothing of the router round (M0-a-05 S14 – S16: insert/insertChain.ts, insert/stretch.ts, insert/snapRound.ts) and writes no file of it. Every cite below was read on the design head 102ff939 (insert/ on origin/wip/child-a05s14 @ 9354851f): re-read every cite on your tree; the files, functions and forms named are binding, the line numbers are not. DECLARED REDS OF THE HEAD, never a failing line (brought to the head of 2026-11-13; where THE MEASURED LIST above names a red of the head differently, this list is the newer): Q152's six M0-a-09 bands tests; J176's Mac-reference bench tests (bench/test/calibrate, host, timing); bench/test/site/summary.test.ts's canary (J772 (7): the committed site summary is stale until the session's re-run — the compose.test.ts and spike.test.ts reds the measured list names beside it were re-pinned since by M0-e-06 S4 and are green); Q153's flake (testkit/test/determinism/dilation.test.ts; re-run alone); and Q202 — the seven 'later rungs' cases of packages/layout/test/enceinte/s5seeds.test.ts, which register only at FULL strength (PLAT_FUZZ_RUNS unset; at 1 000 runs the file reports 'No test found') and are red there since before this round was specced: another item's, re-pinned by a round in flight. THE RESTARTS (a fact of this platform on 2026-11-12 / 13: a container restarts about every two hours whether or not background tasks are live; /home/user/maps-scratch survives, every process dies, /tmp does not survive): every run over ten minutes is a STEP OF A RE-ENTRANT CHAIN under /home/user/maps-scratch/waves/ — its log and its exit-code file beside it, and for a run of many parts one exit-code file per part, so that a seat that comes back after a restart skips what is finished: the census one file per seed or family; RELATED@1000 IN CHUNKS — collect RELATED's own file list once (`vitest related --run` with the JSON reporter and a test-name filter that matches nothing, e.g. -t '^__no_such_test__$'), split it by 12 files, run each chunk with `vitest run --passWithNoTests` at PLAT_FUZZ_RUNS=1000 under ONE recorded PLAT_FUZZ_SEED, each chunk's JSON report and exit code beside it, the totals summed from the JSON reports (a file that registers no test at 1 000 runs is named); NEAR one run per project; each mutant its own exit-code file. A CHECKPOINT line names the chain's directory and its next unfinished step at least every twenty minutes of the seat's own work. No timing bar is judged on these machines. THE SEATS: the session's tiers for a stage item (J390 / J631 / J714), named at launch; the CLOSING CHECK is the STRONGER checker's — this leg changes SOURCE. THE WAITING RULE and the waiter as the brief above says. LEG 2's OWN TEXT. The write scope is the item's owns: plat/packages/site/src/water/ and plat/packages/site/test/water/ — nothing else; kernel/, layout/, testkit/ and bench/ are read and run, never edited. Leg 1's `refused` field (tx/types.ts TxResult, through `Kernel['tx']`) is on your tree: read leg 1's notes section 'Hardening round S11' and its pins first. THE DECLARED SHIFT: NONE — LINE 1 shows it. THE ORDER OF WORK: the equivalence oracle first (green on the base, where the reader is still the regex), then the reader and its pins, then the before / after. THE LIST FOR THE SESSION'S SEAMS (written in the notes, never edited here): queue Q205 and L26 (closed by this leg if it passes); docs/validation/hardening-retriage-2026-10-19/B7.md's L26 row; any other item's test that moves (owner, file, test, before, after). Notes section 'Hardening round S6'; verdict plat/docs/build/checks/M0-e-03-s6.md; lanes build/M0-e-03-fix-s6 / check/M0-e-03-close-s6 (free at this writing; re-keyed by the session if a key appears); ledger ids the next free at build time.

lines.required_change: FIX: waterFaces keeps the batch's `refused` on its refusal (present only when the kernel's result carried it; the text unchanged); the `Attempt` failure arm gains `refused?: RoleKey`, carried by water() from waterFaces (absent on the polygon refusals water() makes itself); runS1 reads `const named = attempt.refused?.role === 'shore' ? attempt.refused.entity : undefined;` — SHORE ONLY, as the regex read [SESSION: Q6] — and the regex and its 'message contract' comment go, the comment saying the stage reads the kernel's structured field (RL13). Every refusal text of the stage byte-identical. PINS (site/test/water/, the consumer side of the seam): (P1) a façade whose FIRST water batch (`kernel.tx` with S1's L0 spec) returns `{ ok: false, code: 'E_INVARIANT', detail: 'planted: this text names no body', refused: { role: 'shore', entity: 'water:tributary:0', ordinal: 0 } }`, on a river and a tributary with no fast ring left to retry: the tributary is dropped `refused` and the water re-run commits the river (red with the regex: the text names nothing, the stage stops); (P2) the same naming the river: the stage refuses E_INVARIANT with the 'no further rung' text, nothing of the water written; (P3) an estuary named: `mouth` none, the estuary dropped `refused`, the river kept whole; (P4) a text that DOES print `(shore, water:tributary:0)` and carries NO field: the stage stops as for an unnamed refusal (red with the regex); (P5) `refused` with role 'bank' and the tributary's id: the stage stops, nothing dropped. EQUIVALENCE ORACLE (a test keeping the old regex as its oracle): over the before / after runs below, a façade watching every S1 water batch asserts for each refusal `regexName(detail) === (refused?.role === 'shore' ? refused.entity : undefined)` and states how many named refusals it saw (a count of 0 is said, never hidden). MUTANTS: M1 the regex restored (P1, P4 red); M2 waterFaces drops the field (P1 red); M3 the role filter removed (P5 red); M4 the entity mis-read (P1–P3 red). NO-SHIFT, SHOWN: before (the base: leg 1 landed, the regex reader) and after, at one recorded seed — x-06's EP-01/S1 cells (five kinds × their seeds: each run's handling, rung, code and detail), the item's exit-bar seeds and NEAR families, and a DECLARED site sample (relief-60 and relief-3000, default configuration, seeds 1–40: per seed the S1 report's `dropped`, `retried` and `fallbacks`, every S1 refusal's code and detail, and the L0 level digest at S1's end) — identical; the item's refusal census identical (J264).
